confirm.title: Re-enable automatic recovery
confirm.description: Home Assistant received Casambi state messages, but this Casambi MQTT entry did not process them, and automatic reloads of the entry did not fix it. No further automatic reloads are made. The reason is shown on the entry's Casambi health sensor. Check the Home Assistant log, then submit to re-enable automatic recovery for this entry within the normal limits.

bridge_unsupported.title: Casambi MQTT bridge does not report health
bridge_unsupported.description: The Casambi bridge does not answer the health protocol. Either it is an older bridge, or it is not running at the moment; the two cannot be told apart until it answers. Lights, scenes and switches of an older bridge keep working, but stuck updates cannot be detected or recovered. If the bridge is running, update it on its Bluetooth host to the release that matches this integration. This notice disappears by itself once the bridge answers.
